import math

def solve(bounds: list[float], rates: list[float], k: float, A0: float, h: float) -> tuple[list[float], list[float], list[float], float]:
    k = k
    a = A0
    reference = a
    times = [bounds[0]]
    amounts = [a]
    exact = [reference]

    def propagate(a, u, t):
        return a + u * t if k == 0 else a * math.exp(-k * t) - u / k * math.expm1(-k * t)
    for left, right, u in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:], rates):
        n = math.ceil((right - left) / h - 1e-12)
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            t = min(left + i * h, right)
            dt = t - times[-1]
            a += dt * (u - k * a)
            times.append(t)
            amounts.append(a)
            exact.append(propagate(reference, u, t - left))
        reference = propagate(reference, u, right - left)
    return (times, amounts, exact, max((abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(amounts, exact))))
